ValidationRule.description: L2/L3 users cannot assign the case directly to any CR workbasket. Please Escalate this case by setting status field to 'Escalated'.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c), NOT(ISCHANGED( Status )), OR( $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Banker', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Banker_Line_Manager' ), ISCHANGED( OwnerId ), BEGINS(OwnerId , '00G'), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'General_Inquiry' ), NOT( Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = "Hardship_IDR_Letter") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: L2/L3 users cannot assign the case directly to any CR workbasket. Please Escalate this case by setting status field to 'Escalated'.
